independent_checks: Read complete helper, analysis CLI and five tests; new component imports no native runtime. Actual independent CPU invocation confirmed no mlx or mlx_vlm modules loaded.

Processor casts only to supplied float32 dtype, rejects unexpected dtype/shape, returns the result without in-place writes, and append helper copies the caller list with upcast last. Independent float16/float32/float64 NumPy input tests preserved shape and original data even after mutating the returned NumPy array.

Inspected pinned ordinary AR source hook ordering through actual analyzer AST: custom processors appended after built-ins, processor return replaces logits before direct logsumexp, no intervening logits reassignment. Guard nonempty y and final-processor position are explicit; no general batch/speculative/fused claim.

Independently derived exact-representable BF16 logits64/63: mathematical logsumexp64+log1p(exp(-1)) rounds to64.5 in IEEE BF16 nearest-even, yielding fixture logps -.5/-1.5. Independent closed-form log1p reference and explicit NumPy F32 subtraction reproduce errors/probability sums within1e-12.

Executed only the CPU analysis function on already closed evidence and reproduced the complete frozen aggregate exactly, including source hashes, saved17-token differences, .002 failures,1942/504 state-fingerprint claims and1050-byte release.
Checked public result uses scalar/synthetic aggregates and hashes; it contains no patient identifiers, patient paths, raw response strings, real token IDs or real per-token likelihood vectors.
limitations: IEEE BF16 nearest-even fixture models arithmetic rounding, not bitwise execution of any MLX reduction kernel. NumPy alias/copy tests establish CPU behavior; no native allocation-ownership guarantee is inferred.

Future caller must pass this component as the final custom processor in the inspected ordinary AR path. The helper has not been installed into or executed by a native rollout; existing v3/frozen training sources and checkpoints remain unchanged.

FP32 normalization cannot restore precision already lost in model-produced BF16 logits and does not address KV/full-forward differences. Saved F32 KV/full residual .009733378887176514 still FAILS .002; full parity is not solved.

Existing historical generation logps and complete historical input fingerprints remain PARTIAL. This component does not recover the historical sampler distribution or prove a historical training failure cause.

No clinical/MRI accuracy, grounding, task-generalization or training-gain claim. This CPU review does not authorize a native rerun, new backward, optimizer update, generation, modified threshold or training launch.
review_scope: New future processor and CPU arithmetic/saved-evidence analysis only; no native launch or integration approval.
